About Air Quality Testers

Air Quality Testers is an independent environmental consulting firm specializing in science-based environmental testing, building investigations, and indoor environmental assessments.

AQT performs third-party testing and consulting and does not perform remediation. This allows our consultants to provide clients with objective findings and independent recommendations.

Our services include:

Mold and moisture assessments

Indoor air quality testing

VOC and formaldehyde testing

Asbestos inspections and sampling

Lead inspections and testing

Fire and smoke contamination assessments

Industrial hygiene services

Allergen testing

Water and soil testing

Post-remediation verification

Building-related environmental consulting

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and certified Environmental Consultant who is comfortable managing the full client experience—from the initial consultation and project sale through inspection, sampling, documentation, and final recommendations.

AQT provides inbound client opportunities, environmental testing equipment, personal protective equipment, laboratory coordination, operational support, and report-production assistance.

This position is designed for a consultant who wants the flexibility of a part-time to full-time schedule, hourly security, and significant commission-based earning potential.

Consultants who provide excellent service, close more projects, and appropriately expand project scopes can substantially increase their earnings.

Primary Responsibilities

Consult with inbound residential and commercial clients

Understand client concerns and recommend appropriate environmental testing

Develop project scopes, pricing, and sampling plans

Close assigned client opportunities

Schedule and confirm projects

Identify appropriate additional testing when site conditions support it

Perform environmental inspections and sample collection

Conduct moisture, infrared, and visual building assessments

Inspect attics, crawlspaces, and other accessible building areas when safe

Document observations through photographs, videos, and detailed field notes

Complete chain-of-custody and laboratory documentation

Maintain accurate project, CRM, and timekeeping records

Communicate preliminary observations professionally without overstating findings

Review laboratory results and report drafts

Add project-specific findings, recommendations, and corrections

Coordinate with AQT’s report-writing and quality-assurance team

Maintain and protect company equipment

Follow company safety, ethical, and quality-control procedures

Hourly Compensation

The consultant is paid hourly for all compensable work, including:

Consultants using an approved personal vehicle for authorized company business receive separate mileage reimbursement, plus reimbursement for approved parking and tolls.

10% of qualifying collected AQT service revenue from projects personally closed by the consultant.

When commission is paid

Commission is uncapped, meaning there is no maximum amount the consultant can earn from qualifying revenue.

Currently holds at least one relevant environmental, indoor-air-quality, mold, asbestos, lead, industrial-hygiene, or building-science certification

Professional experience performing environmental inspections, testing, sampling, or building assessments

Strong client-consultation and sales-closing ability

Strong technical documentation and report-review skills

Ability to explain technical information clearly and professionally

Strong attention to detail and commitment to objective consulting

Ability to work independently in residential and commercial environments

Comfortable accessing attics, crawlspaces, and other building areas when safe

Acceptable driving history

Reliable transportation for field assignments

Ability to use mobile applications, CRM systems, and digital reporting tools

Ability to follow company procedures, safety requirements, and quality standards

Work Schedule and Territory

This is a flexible field-based position serving Northern California and the San Francisco Bay Area.

The position may range from part-time to full-time, depending on consultant availability, client demand, project location, certifications, geographic routing, and business needs.

Consultants may complete multiple projects in one day and may travel throughout their assigned service territory.

AQT does not guarantee a fixed number of projects, hours, or a 40-hour workweek.

Technically experienced

Properly certified

Professional with clients

Confident discussing pricing and project scope

Persuasive without being aggressive

Honest and objective

Organized and responsive

Flexible scheduling, hourly security, uncapped commission, company-generated opportunities, and a clear path into senior consulting or project management.
